sentences.text:
As per para 16 of the bail petition, the accused declares following criminal antecedents:-
Sr. No. FIR No. Date Offences Police Station 1. 108 24.7.2021 409 and 120-B IPC and Sections --- 13 & 7 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
3. The allegations against the petitioner are that he in connivance with co-accused Shyam Singh (Sarpanch) leased out the village land at much lesser price than the previous years.
As per Punjab Village Common Lands (Regulation) Act, 1961, not more than 10 acres of land can be leased out to an individual.
However, the petitioner and his co-accused, flouting the said rules, allotted land beyond 10 acres.
It has also been 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:136745 alleged that the accused misappropriated the panchayat funds in connivance with each other.

4. Vide order dated 6.9.2023, this Court had granted interim bail to the petitioner, primarily because the petitioner's counsel had stated that they would have no objection in case this Court imposes any stringent conditions including declaration of assets.
The said order is continuing till date.
5. Counsel for the petitioner submits that he has voluntarily complied with the conditions mentioned in the order dated 6.9.2023.
6. State has not disputed the contention made by counsel for the petitioner.
7. Given above, the petition is allowed and interim order dated 6.9.2023 is made absolute.
All pending applications, if any, stand disposed.

(ANOOP CHITKARA)
 JUDGE October 19, 2023 AK
